summary: Plutonian Acquisition Corp. II filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its IPO on April 29, 2026, issuing 10,000,000 units at $10.00/unit for gross proceeds of $100M, with each unit consisting of one Class A ordinary share and a right to receive one-fourth of a Class A share upon a business combination. Simultaneously, it closed a private placement of 210,000 private units to Plutonian Capital II LLC at $10.00/unit for $2.1M. The filing includes an audited balance sheet. This is a standard SPAC IPO closing 8-K, constituting a special situation as a blank-check company event. Watch for future business combination announcement.
